labels.assign_registered_signatory: Do you want to assign a previously registered legal representative or signatory as a Bancanet superuser?
labels.approver_superuser_id: Select the superuser who will approve transactions
labels.mark_all_features: Do you want to enable all features?
labels.transfer_third_party_same_country: Transfer - LAFISE third parties, same country: lets you transfer funds to third-party accounts at Banco LAFISE.
labels.transfer_third_party_regional: Transfer - LAFISE third parties, regional: lets you transfer funds to third-party accounts at the other banks of Grupo Financiero LAFISE.
labels.transfer_abroad: Transfer - abroad: lets you transfer funds to banks in other countries.
labels.manage_permissions: Manage - Permissions: lets the superuser grant the users they designated permission to view, prepare and approve monetary or non-monetary transactions.
labels.manage_daily_limits: Manage - Daily transaction limits: lets the superuser set maximum transaction limits for the users they designated.
labels.manage_audits: Manage - Audits: lets the superuser review the permissions and transfers made by the users they designated.
labels.manage_lafiservicios_subscriptions: Manage - LAFISERVICIOS subscriptions: lets you edit and remove the services to pay that the client registered earlier.
labels.manage_debit_card_pin_change: Manage - Debit card PIN change: lets you generate a new PIN for the debit card.
labels.personal_settings_ni: Settings - My personal settings: lets you choose how you want to be notified about the transactions made.
labels.personal_settings_cr: Settings - My personal settings: lets you choose how you want to be notified about the transactions made.
labels.pay_lafiservicios: Pay - LAFISERVICIOS: lets you pay third parties, public or private service providers that contracted this payment option with Banco LAFISE.
labels.pay_third_party_credit_card: Pay - Third-party credit card: lets you pay third-party credit cards at Banco LAFISE.
labels.pay_own_credit_card: Credit cards - Own card payment: lets you pay the balance of your own credit card at Banco LAFISE.
labels.pay_third_party_loans: Pay - Third-party loans: lets you pay third-party loans at Banco LAFISE.
labels.pay_suppliers: Pay - Suppliers: lets you pay suppliers with beneficiaries at Banco LAFISE or via ACH to local banks.
labels.pay_payroll: Pay - Payroll: lets you pay payroll to one or more beneficiaries at Banco LAFISE or via ACH to local banks.
labels.transfer_other_banks_eccapps: Transfer - Other banks via ECCAPPS: lets you send funds to other banks in Central America and the Caribbean.
labels.transfer_quick_send: Transfer - Quick Send: lets you send money to other people with a withdrawal code that the receiver can use to withdraw the money at alternative Banco LAFISE channels.
labels.transfer_local_bank: Transfer - To a local bank: lets you send funds to other banks in the country via ACH or TEF.
labels.transfer_prepaid_card_top_up: Transfer - Third-party prepaid card top-up: lets you top up third-party prepaid cards at Banco LAFISE.

hints.mark_all_features: Answering yes turns on every feature available in the country.
